title: The plan's CI task demands a cloudbuild.yaml the platform removes; a judge that still lists it labels it IMAGE_BUILD and the finding is satisfied by the platform
source: example 01 live run on a fresh install, 11-16 (docs/handoff/ex01-g13-cloudbuild-plan-task-diagnosis.md): the architect's INFRA-05 named cloudbuild.yaml and the platform deploy workflow; the developer wrote cloudbuild.yaml, the developer handler removed it (the platform owns every CI and build file), QA ran 100% tests, and the adherence judge's 'cloudbuild.yaml is missing' finding (no file named) went to the task's one committed target, the platform-rendered deploy workflow, and stopped the run as PLATFORM_DEFECT
mechanism: IMAGE-BUILD-PLATFORM-FACT: a missed directive labelled IMAGE_BUILD on a plan task whose typed kinds are infrastructure or CI/CD is a platform-satisfied directive (kept in the QA evidence, never blocking, never a repair seed); before the fix the label is not in the closed facet set (OTHER) and the finding blocks

task_dag.title: Configure Cloud Native Buildpacks CI/CD Pipeline (Zero Dockerfiles)
task_dag.description: Create cloudbuild.yaml and GitHub Actions workflow using Google Cloud Native Buildpacks (pack build or gcloud builds submit --pack) to build apps/event-router without any Dockerfile and deploy to Cloud Run.
acceptance_criteria: CI/CD pipeline builds container strictly via Google Cloud Native Buildpacks (pack build or gcloud builds submit --pack)
Zero Dockerfiles and zero docker build commands exist in cloudbuild.yaml or workflows

missed.text: cloudbuild.yaml is missing from the repository; INFRA-05 requires cloudbuild.yaml to build the container strictly via Google Cloud Native Buildpacks (pack / --pack)
